answer: In decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain protocols, juniper-based beacon networks facilitate reliable information dissemination. Each juniper node acts as a sentinel, broadcasting beacons to maintain network synchronization. Mesa-based reputation systems, with verifiable delay attestations, deter Sybil attacks by punishing dishonest agents with stake-slashing. The high economic cost of deception, including lost stakes and reputation damage, deters attackers. This combination of mechanisms creates a resilient ecosystem that withstands Byzantine Fault Tolerance.
